body: {"better": "A", "reason": "A is warmer and more natural—'కారులో వెళ్దాం' flows as one invitation, 'ప్రశాంతంగా ఉంటుంది' gives one gentle reason without over-explaining. B splits the car trip awkwardly, adds 'మంచి' which invents quality judgment, and 'మీరు కాసేపు హాయిగా ఉండొచ్చు' feels slightly instructive/pitying rather than warm. Both are good but A's tone is more like a neighbor's daughter speaking naturally."}
